exposed_pad.note: SOT-223 thermal tab (Pin 4 in TI DCY notation) is internally connected to VOUT (Pin 2); NEVER connect tab to GND (p.3).

theta_ja_c_per_w.condition: DCY (SOT-223) JEDEC high-K PCB (Sec 7.4, p.4); degrades substantially on minimal copper pads

tj_max_c.condition: Recommended operating junction temperature max -40°C to +125°C for LM1117I (abs max TJ = 150°C, Sec 7.1 & 7.3)

pinout.name: ADJ
pinout.description: Feedback adjust pin (maintains 1.25 V VREF between VOUT and ADJ; do NOT tie directly to GND unless 1.25 V output is desired)

pinout.name: VOUT
pinout.description: Adjustable regulated output (1.25 V to 13.8 V), internally connected to SOT-223 thermal tab (Pin 4); requires >= 10 µF tantalum COUT (0.3-22 Ω ESR)

pinout.name: VIN
pinout.description: Unregulated input supply (VOUT + 1.4 V minimum to 15 V operating; 20 V absolute maximum)

vin_abs_max_v.condition: Absolute Maximum Ratings VIN to GND = 20 V

vin_min_v.condition: Minimum VIN at VOUT = 1.25 V (requires 1.4 V <= VIN - VOUT <= 10 V for guaranteed VREF regulation across 10-800 mA)

vin_max_v.condition: Recommended Operating Conditions maximum VIN to GND = 15 V (VOUT adjustable up to 13.8 V)

vout_v.condition: Vref (adjustable 1.25V–13.8V): VOUT = VREF * (1 + R2/R1) + IADJ * R2; LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB Active on p.25 (marking N03B)

vout_tolerance_pct.condition: LM1117I-ADJ VREF: 1.238 V to 1.262 V (±0.96%, ~±1%) at TJ = 25°C, IOUT = 10 mA; widens to 1.20 V to 1.29 V over -40°C to +125°C

iout_max_ma.condition: Rated continuous output current 800 mA (current limit 800 mA min / 1200 mA typ / 1500 mA max, p.8)

iq_typ_ua.condition: LM1117I-ADJ minimum load / quiescent current discharged into VOUT = 1.7 mA typ at 25°C (5 mA max over -40°C to +125°C; IADJ = 60 µA typ / 120 µA max)

dropout_typ_mv.condition: LM1117I at IOUT = 800 mA, TJ = 25°C (1400 mV max over -40°C to +125°C; 1.1 V typ at 100 mA, 1.15 V typ at 500 mA)

psrr_db.condition: f = 120 Hz, VIN - VOUT = 3 V, VRIPPLE = 1 Vpp, TJ = 25°C (60 dB min over -40°C to +125°C; CADJ bypass improves ripple rejection)

output_noise_uvrms.condition: 0.003% of 1.25 V VREF = 37.5 µVRMS (10 Hz to 10 kHz, TJ = 25°C; scales proportionally with programmed VOUT)

min_cout_uf.condition: Minimum 10 µF solid tantalum output capacitor required (use >= 22 µF if CADJ bypass capacitor is fitted)

esr_min_ohm.condition: Strict lower ESR floor of 0.3 Ω — bare low-ESR MLCCs (< 10 mΩ) cause loop oscillation

esr_max_ohm.condition: Upper ESR ceiling of 22 Ω for loop stability across operating range

design_gotchas.title: Pin 1 Is ADJ (NOT GND) — NEVER Drop Into Fixed 3.3 V / 5.0 V Footprints Without Feedback Resistors
design_gotchas.detail: LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB (marking N03B) regulates 1.25 V between VOUT (Pin 2) and ADJ (Pin 1). Populating it directly onto a fixed-LDO PCB where Pin 1 is tied to GND collapses the rail to 1.25 V instead of 3.3 V or 5.0 V.

design_gotchas.title: Mandatory >= 5 mA Minimum Load Current (Size Top Resistor R1 <= 121 Ω–240 Ω)
design_gotchas.detail: Because LM1117I-ADJ has no separate GND pin, its internal quiescent current (1.7 mA typ, 5 mA max) exits through VOUT. If the external feedback divider draws less than 5 mA (requiring R1 <= 249 Ω, typically 121 Ω for 10 mA) and load drops to zero, VOUT floats uncontrollably upward toward VIN.

design_gotchas.title: Strict 0.3–22 Ω Output Capacitor ESR Window & 22 µF Requirement With CADJ Bypass
design_gotchas.detail: Requires >= 10 µF tantalum COUT with ESR strictly in 0.3–22 Ω (unstable with direct MLCCs). Adding a 10 µF CADJ bypass capacitor for maximum PSRR increases the minimum required COUT to 22 µF tantalum.

design_gotchas.title: IADJ Error Term (60 µA Typ / 120 µA Max) Must Be Accounted for When Choosing R2
design_gotchas.detail: VOUT = 1.25 V * (1 + R2/R1) + IADJ * R2. Keeping R1 small (121 Ω–240 Ω) both satisfies the 5 mA–10 mA minimum load rule and keeps the IADJ * R2 error term negligible (< 30 mV).

typical_use_cases: Custom non-standard voltage rails (1.25 V to 13.8 V) such as 1.5 V, 2.8 V, 4.2 V, or 9.0 V at up to 800 mA
Unified single-SKU BOM consolidation replacing multiple fixed 1117 voltage options via E96 feedback dividers
Constant-current LED or battery pre-charge regulators using the fixed 1.25 V VOUT-to-ADJ reference
Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ) linear post-regulators with optional CADJ ripple-rejection bypass
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB is an industrial-grade (-40°C to +125°C TJ) adjustable 800 mA linear regulator in SOT-223 (DCY) supporting output voltages from 1.25 V to 13.8 V via two external resistors around its ±1% 1.25 V VREF. Unlike fixed LM1117 variants, Pin 1 is ADJ (not GND), and internal bias current exits via VOUT, demanding a 5 mA worst-case minimum load (typically set by R1 = 121 Ω–240 Ω). Engineers must also respect the 0.3–22 Ω tantalum COUT ESR window, VOUT-connected thermal tab, and 1.2 V typ (1.4 V max) dropout.

audit_notes: Vision-verified DCY SOT-223 Top View on 300 DPI PNG page 3 (Figure 6-1 & Table 6-1): Pin 1 = ADJ, Pin 2 = VOUT (Tab = VOUT), Pin 3 = VIN.

Verified Absolute Maximum Ratings (20 V VIN, 150°C TJ), Recommended Operating Conditions (15 V max, -40 to 125°C TJ for LM1117I), and DCY Thermal Metrics (RθJA = 61.6 °C/W, RθJC(top) = 42.5 °C/W) on 300 DPI PNG page 4.

Verified Section 7.6 LM1117I-ADJ specs on 300 DPI PNG pages 7-8: VREF = 1.25 V (1.238-1.262 V at 25°C, 1.20-1.29 V over temp), VIN-VOUT min = 1.4 V (VIN min 2.65 V at 1.25 V out), minimum load current = 1.7 mA typ / 5 mA max, IADJ = 60 µA typ / 120 µA max, dropout = 1.2 V typ at 800 mA.
